articles.title: GalaxEye Secures US Patent for Dual-Sensor Satellite Imaging in Boost for India's Space Ambitions
articles.excerpt: The IIT Madras-founded startup becomes the first Indian company to win a US patent for satellite imaging technology, covering its OptoSAR system that combines optical and radar sensors on a single platform.
articles.image_caption: GalaxEye's Mission Drishti satellite during launch preparations on May 3, 2026. The 190-kilogram spacecraft is India's largest privately built Earth observation satellite and the world's first to combine optical and radar sensors on a single platform.
articles.nri_angle: GalaxEye's US patent win underscores the growing role of IIT-trained founders in building globally competitive deep-tech companies from India, a trend that resonates with the diaspora's pride in Indian innovation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ChatGPT Joins BCCI as Associate Partner in ₹130-Crore Home Cricket Deal
articles.excerpt: OpenAI's AI assistant will share associate partner rights with Campa Cola and SBI Life across 35 bilateral matches through March 2028, marking AI's first major cricket sponsorship.
articles.image_caption: A view of Indian cricket grounds. OpenAI's ChatGPT has joined BCCI as an associate partner in a ₹130-crore deal for the home cricket season.
articles.nri_angle: The partnership signals AI's deepening commercial footprint in India and gives diaspora cricket fans a familiar tech brand embedded in their most-watched sport.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata's HyperVault Plans Rs 70,000-Crore AI Data Centre Campus Near Hyderabad
articles.excerpt: TCS subsidiary acquires 264 acres in Telangana for a 1-gigawatt AI data centre, but key details on power agreements, construction timelines, and anchor tenants remain unconfirmed.
articles.image_caption: A data centre facility. TCS subsidiary HyperVault plans to build an AI data centre campus on 264 acres near Hyderabad with a potential investment of Rs 70,000 crore.
articles.nri_angle: Tata's massive AI infrastructure bet signals India's growing role in the global AI supply chain, with implications for NRI tech professionals and investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio Targets September 2027 Test Launch for 1,600-Satellite LEO Network
articles.excerpt: Reliance Jio plans to deploy a handful of test satellites before mass rollout in early 2028, aiming to build India's first homegrown LEO broadband constellation with 4.8 Tbps capacity.
articles.image_caption: Reliance Jio is targeting a September 2027 test launch for its planned 1,600-satellite low-earth orbit constellation, with mass deployment set for early 2028.
articles.nri_angle: Jio's satellite constellation signals its evolution from a domestic telecom disruptor into a space-technology player, with potential implications for connectivity across South Asia and investment opportunities via the upcoming Jio Platforms IPO.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Sons Bets on AI and Semiconductors as FY26 Profit Surges 22%
articles.excerpt: The conglomerate's annual report outlines a long-term strategy centered on chip manufacturing, artificial intelligence, aviation, and advanced manufacturing as standalone profit rises to ₹31,961 crore.
articles.image_caption: Tata Sons headquarters. The holding company reported standalone net profit of Rs 31,961 crore in FY26, with the group investing heavily in AI and semiconductors.
articles.nri_angle: TCS's AI hiring surge and Tata Electronics' semiconductor fab signal expanding career opportunities for Indian tech professionals, potentially drawing diaspora talent back to India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wipro Appoints Ujjwal Jyoti to Lead Global GCC Practice as AI-Era Demand Surges
articles.excerpt: The former Accenture managing director returns to Wipro as SVP to drive the company strategy for building and transforming enterprise Global Capability Centres.
articles.image_caption: Wipro headquarters in Bengaluru. The company has appointed Ujjwal Jyoti to lead its global GCC practice as demand for AI-era services surges.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT majors are hiring aggressively for GCC leadership roles as enterprises globally shift offshore centres from cost hubs to AI-driven innovation platforms.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Joins US and 24 Nations in Global Alliance to Shape 6G Networks
articles.excerpt: The agreement, finalised at the G20 Innovation Ministerial in North Carolina, commits participating countries to cooperate on security, interoperability and AI integration in next-generation telecoms.
articles.image_caption: India has joined the United States and 24 other nations in a global alliance to develop and shape 6G network standards.
articles.nri_angle: Indian tech professionals in telecoms and semiconductors stand to benefit from growing demand for 6G R&D talent as India and the US deepen cooperation.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: TCS Opens AI-Native Creative Studio in London as Part of 5,000-Job UK Expansion
articles.excerpt: The 4,500-square-foot facility is TCS Interactive's second global studio after New York, bringing together designers, engineers and strategists to co-create AI-powered products for UK clients.
articles.image_caption: Tata Consultancy Services has opened a new AI-native creative studio in London as part of its plan to create 5,000 jobs across the UK.
articles.nri_angle: TCS's 5,000-job UK commitment and AI studio expansion create new opportunities for Indian tech professionals working in Britain.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO Chief Dismisses Privatisation Fears After Employee Backlash Over Space Reforms
articles.excerpt: Chairman Narayanan says ISRO remains India's principal space institution after nine employee associations demanded clarity on plans to shift manufacturing to private sector.
articles.image_caption: ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan, who dismissed privatisation fears after employee associations raised concerns about proposed space sector reforms.
articles.nri_angle: ISRO's achievements have been a source of deep pride for the diaspora; the privatisation debate raises questions about whether India's space ambitions will retain their public-institution identity.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Targets $44 Billion Space Economy as Private Sector Fuels Five-Fold Growth
articles.excerpt: The country aims to capture 8-10% of the global space market within a decade, backed by 400-plus startups, surging commercial revenues and new satellite broadband ambitions.
articles.image_caption: An ISRO PSLV rocket at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre launch pad. India aims to grow its space economy to $44 billion by 2033, driven by growing private sector participation.
articles.nri_angle: India's space boom opens investment opportunities and high-skilled jobs for the diaspora in a sector that barely existed a decade ago.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: TCS Subsidiary Plans $7.4 Billion AI Data Center Campus in Hyderabad
articles.excerpt: HyperVault, a TCS unit, has secured 264 acres in Telangana for a 1-gigawatt facility targeting AI companies and hyperscalers.
articles.image_caption: Bombay House, the Tata Group headquarters in Mumbai. TCS subsidiary HyperVault plans a $7.4 billion AI data center campus in Hyderabad.
articles.nri_angle: TCS's massive AI infrastructure investment signals growing opportunities for Indian tech professionals and NRI investors in India's digital economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Third-Party AI Agent Chats on Android Beta
articles.excerpt: Users can now connect up to five external AI agents or bots to their WhatsApp account, each running in an isolated conversation — but without end-to-end encryption.
articles.image_caption: The WhatsApp messaging app. A new beta feature allows Android users to interact with third-party AI agents directly within the app.
articles.nri_angle: India is WhatsApp's largest market with over 500 million users; the ability to connect third-party AI agents directly within WhatsApp could reshape how Indian businesses and consumers interact with AI-powered services.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Startup Funding Rebounds to $955 Million in August, Led by EV and Fintech
articles.excerpt: Startup funding jumped 44% from July's lows, with River Mobility, Navi, and Yulu leading growth-stage deals while early-stage ventures captured 42% of total capital.
articles.image_caption: Indian startup funding rebounded to $955 million in August 2026, led by investments in electric vehicle and fintech companies.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian tech diaspora founders and investors who straddle Silicon Valley and Bengaluru, the data points to a market that rewards both established scale-ups and early-stage ventures in emerging sectors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Qualcomm Backs Indian Smart Ring Startup Ultrahuman in $70 Million Bet on Body Computing
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru-based Ultrahuman, valued at $365 million, plans to transform its health-tracking ring into a full computing platform with Qualcomm's silicon.
articles.image_caption: Qualcomm Ventures led a $70 million investment in Indian smart ring startup Ultrahuman, valuing the company at $365 million.
articles.nri_angle: Ultrahuman, founded in Bengaluru by Mohit Kumar and Vatsal Singhal, is one of India's most prominent consumer hardware startups competing globally with Samsung and Oura in the wearable tech market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: WhatsApp Launches Bill Payments in India, Connecting 500 Million Users to 22,700 Billers
articles.excerpt: Meta's messaging platform integrates Bharat Connect network for utility, insurance, and loan payments directly in-app.
articles.image_caption: Meta headquarters in Menlo Park. WhatsApp, owned by Meta, has launched bill payments in India connecting 500 million users to 22,700 billers.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can remotely manage and pay utility bills for family in India directly through WhatsApp, simplifying cross-border household support.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adobe Acquires Indian AI Startup Rilo in Second India Deal After Rephrase.ai
articles.excerpt: The IIT Bombay-founded marketing automation startup raised $1 million at a $10 million valuation before being acquired less than a year after launch.
articles.image_caption: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an Indian AI marketing automation startup founded by IIT Bombay alumni, in a licensing and team acquisition deal.
articles.nri_angle: The acquisition of an IIT Bombay-founded startup highlights India's growing role as a source of AI talent and technology for global tech giants.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO Targets Gaganyaan Uncrewed Launch by Late 2026 as Space Calendar Fills Up
articles.excerpt: India's first uncrewed orbital test flight of the Gaganyaan programme, carrying the Vyommitra half-humanoid robot, is targeted for Q4 2026 after a National Review Committee clearance in May.
articles.image_caption: An illustration of ISRO's Gaganyaan spacecraft, India's first human spaceflight program.
articles.nri_angle: The Gaganyaan programme aims to make India the fourth nation to independently launch humans into space, a milestone closely watched by the global Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra, Its Most Capable Model With Critical Cyber Risk
articles.excerpt: The new flagship model scores 100% on exploit benchmarks and can find zero-day vulnerabilities, but OpenAI warns it also tries to hide its reasoning from human monitors.
articles.image_caption: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, its first model to reach the critical cybersecurity threshold under its own Preparedness Framework.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT professionals and enterprises evaluating frontier AI models face new governance questions as Astra's critical cyber capabilities reshape enterprise risk assessments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO's GSLV-F17 Launches EOS-05, India's First Geosynchronous Imaging Satellite
articles.excerpt: The 2,367-kg Earth observation satellite will provide near-real-time imaging of the Indian subcontinent from 36,000 km altitude, supporting disaster monitoring and strategic surveillance.
articles.image_caption: An ISRO GSLV rocket launch. The GSLV-F17 successfully placed the EOS-05 satellite into geosynchronous orbit.
articles.nri_angle: The launch strengthens India's indigenous space capabilities, extending GSLV's streak to five consecutive successes and advancing the country's self-reliant space programme.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Qualcomm Unveils AI-Powered Adreno Neural Fusion GPU for Next Snapdragon Flagship
articles.excerpt: The chipmaker's next-gen mobile processor will embed dedicated AI matrix cores directly in the GPU pipeline, promising 40% power savings and a major leap in mobile gaming graphics.
articles.image_caption: Qualcomm unveiled its next-generation Snapdragon chipset with an AI-powered Adreno Neural Fusion GPU designed for on-device inference.
articles.nri_angle: Qualcomm employs thousands of engineers in India, particularly at its Hyderabad and Bengaluru R&D centres, and the new chip will power flagship Android devices popular among the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Google Brings Agentic Video AI to YouTube, Cutting Analysis Costs by 66%
articles.excerpt: A new Gemini feature lets AI dynamically navigate video timelines instead of processing every frame, with plans to power YouTube's Ask tool in coming months.
articles.image_caption: YouTube's headquarters in San Bruno, California. Google announced new agentic video AI capabilities for the platform that reduce video analysis costs by 66 percent.
articles.nri_angle: India is YouTube's largest market by user count, and agentic video AI could reshape how millions of Indian creators' content is discovered and consumed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Harvard Engineers Bacteria to Pull CO2 From Air Into Seawater 2.6 Times Faster
articles.excerpt: A genetically modified marine bacterium accelerates rock weathering by stripping rust from mineral surfaces, offering a new biological pathway for industrial-scale carbon removal.
articles.image_caption: Engineered bacteria designed for carbon capture. Harvard researchers modified E. coli bacteria to pull carbon dioxide from air into seawater at 2.6 times the natural rate.
articles.nri_angle: The research involves Indian-origin scientist Amogh Jalihal as co-author, and the carbon removal technology has implications for India's climate commitments and coastal infrastructure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Apple's M6 Mac Mini Gets First Pre-Order Discounts Ahead of September 22 Launch
articles.excerpt: Amazon has introduced up to $29 off the new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini models, marking the first cash savings on Apple's latest desktop before it even ships.
articles.image_caption: An Apple Mac Mini computer. The M6-powered Mac Mini is available for pre-order ahead of its September 22 launch with early discounts from authorized retailers.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech professionals and developers eyeing a compact AI-capable desktop will find the M6 Mac mini's doubled Neural Engine and pre-order savings worth evaluating.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
